as_told.title: Obama walks back the aliens remark; Trump takes the bait

plain: Former President Barack Obama is said to have spoken about Area 51, the secret military base in Nevada, and about alien beings kept underground there, and then to have taken it back. Michels says so on the show, adding that Obama "sort of walked his statement back." A guest named Bryce Zabel tells it with more urgency. He says "the very next day, he had to buy it back," and that Donald Trump took the bait. If the remark was meant seriously, it would be a former president hinting that the government holds aliens.
